## `neuro.arrayBuffer.slice`

Instance method on `ArrayBuffer.prototype`.

> Returns a section of an ArrayBuffer.

## Signatures

```ts
slice(input: { arrayBuffer: <receiver>; begin?: number; end?: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<ArrayBuffer>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `ArrayBuffer.prototype.slice` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
